notes: DRAFT tutorial text (no existing Sensei's Lesson format found in content/ or code docs, so this is a new format). One short sentence per screen, read-aloud friendly. Mechanics from docs/decisions.md: basic attacks are automatic; Strike costs 30 Focus and pulses when ready; red circle + '!' = wind-up, circle holds nearly full during the Perfect window; Counter early in the 0.5 s guard = Block; Dash is above Counter, 2.5 tiles, 1.5 s recharge. Lessons 3-6 pair with Learning proposal 6 (guided first Counter: slowdown, pulsing Counter, help fades). 'success' shows after the player lands it; 'retry' if they miss (never a penalty). Each lesson shows once per profile.
speaker: sensei

lessons.trigger: First room of the first run, before any enemy moves
screens: You punch all by yourself when you are close.

lessons.trigger: First time the Strike button fills and pulses (30 Focus)
screens: Tap it for a big, strong hit.

lessons.trigger: First '!' and red circle seen (game slows for the guided Counter)
During the slowdown, as the circle nears full; Counter button pulses
Second '!' seen (smaller slowdown or none, Counter still pulses)
Third '!' seen (no slowdown; small pulse only)
After the first Perfect Counter without help
screens: Tap when the circle is almost full.

lessons.trigger: First Block (Counter pressed a little early)
screens: That was a Block. Good guarding!
Wait a tiny bit longer for Perfect.

lessons.trigger: First time two attacks will land together, or first boss sweep
First time the player walks out of a red circle
